ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High ratio of high-intensity white pixels (approximately 85%) to low-intensity black pixels (approximately 15%) primarily localized at the peripheral margins and specific focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white ventral surface with dispersed tan/yellowish (diatom) pixel clusters across the lower-central regions of both lobes. Continuous black pigmentation band along the trailing edge and tips. A single, distinct, roughly circular black focal spot is located in the upper-medial region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetrical, acute V-shaped notch with a pixel angle of approximately 70-75 degrees and a significant depth relative to the fluke's vertical axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations visible along the entire trailing edge boundary; the distal regions near the tips exhibit more pronounced, jagged peaks (3-5px amplitude) compared to the more attenuated serrations near the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a concave arc from the median notch to the tips, while the overall fluke shape exhibits a strong convex leading edge (submerged) curving toward highly elevated, tapered tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of roughly circular, high-intensity white/gray pixel rosettes (barnacles) localized on the extreme black-pigmented distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of several distinct, dark-toned linear pixel disruptions (scratches or rake marks) situated on the white field near the trailing edge of the left lobe and the lower-outer margin of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible barnacle colonization on both lobe tips; several prominent dark linear rake marks on the ventral surface; extensive yellow-brown staining typical of diatom accumulation.
other_distinctive_markers: Large, prominent yellow-brown staining concentrated around the median notch and lower leading edge area; singular, isolated black spot on the left lobe serves as a high-contrast identifier.
